'''2008 Texas Match Play Championship''' was a Players Committee constructed event in Texas in 2008. [[Kevin Shannon]] won "through the field of 29 people"; [[Scott Lingrell]] was 2nd, and [[Joe Olson]] and [[Greg Shaw]] completed the top 4 (Players Committee news of 1 May 2008).<ref name="pc-sid85">[https://web.archive.org/web/20080803132641/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=85 Kevin Shannon wins the Texas MPC] (1 May 2008), swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 3 August 2008.</ref> The Players Committee's decklist PDF ([[:File:2008 Texas Match Play Championship Day 2.pdf]]) holds eight Day 2 deck printouts (printed 29 April 2008) that give only the players' first names (Greg, Joe, Kevin and Scott), in the file names printed in their footers; the lists are under [[#Day 2 decklists|Day 2 decklists]].

The event was held on Saturday 26 and Sunday 27 April 2008 at Skirmish Games in Deer Park, Texas, in the Houston area about ten minutes from Hobby Airport, with [[Mike Richards|Michael Richards]] as tournament director for all of its events.<ref name="sf-19288-270787">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=270787#p270787 Texas Match Play Championship Details], mr007agent (Michael Richards), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (25 February 2008).</ref><ref name="sf-19288-270804">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=270804#p270804 Texas Match Play Championship Details], mr007agent (Michael Richards), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (25 February 2008).</ref> Shannon and Lingrell received Day 2 automatic bids to the [[2008 World Championship]].<ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], simone89, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008).</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Texas (Skirmish Games, 8351 Spencer Hwy, Deer Park, in the Houston area)<ref name="sf-19288-270787" />
* '''Dates:''' 26–27 April 2008<ref name="sf-19288-270787" />
* '''Players:''' 29<ref name="pc-sid85" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Kevin Shannon]]<ref name="pc-sid85" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Mike Richards|Michael Richards]]<ref name="sf-19288-270804" />
* '''Card pool:''' [[Virtual Set 15: Galactic Frontier|Virtual Set 15]] legal ([[Premiere - Original VS15]])<ref name="sf-19288-270787" />
* '''Entry:''' $25<ref name="sf-19288-270787" />
* '''Structure:''' single-elimination match play, in which each player played his opponent with both decks and the winner of the match moved on; each game had a time limit of 1 hour 15 minutes. The main event's final four played on Sunday.<ref name="sf-19288-270787" />
* '''Prizes:''' glass and an automatic bid to the [[2008 World Championship]] for the winner; 55%, 25%, 10% and 10% of the entry fees to the top four, to which Richards added a $200 donation.<ref name="sf-19288-270787" /><ref name="sf-19288-285332">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=285332#p285332 Texas Match Play Championship Details], mr007agent (Michael Richards), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (31 March 2008).</ref>

The news post promised complete results later; they have not been found.<ref name="pc-sid85" />

In the final, Lingrell played Profit and CCT against Shannon's BHBM and WYS.<ref name="sf-20608-296865">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=296865#p296865 Texas MPC 08 - Saturday Deck Choices], The Franchise (Brad Eier), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (27 April 2008).</ref> According to [[Charles Clarkson]], seven players used WYS, four used Profit and only two played Light Side Senate, neither of whom reached the top four; WYS and Profit were the only Light Side decks in the top four.<ref name="sf-20608-296815">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=296815#p296815 Texas MPC 08 - Saturday Deck Choices], cclarkso (Charles Clarkson), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (27 April 2008).</ref>

== Day 2 decklists ==

The Players Committee's Day 2 PDF has one Dark and one Light printout for each of the four players of Day 2, the final four of the main event.<ref name="sf-19288-270787" /><ref name="pc-tmpc08-pdf">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2008/TMM/Final/2008+Texas+MPC+Day+2.pdf 2008 Texas MPC Day 2.pdf], Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org (sheets printed 29 April 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261014173104/http://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2008/TMM/Final/2008+Texas+MPC+Day+2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Player Name boxes are blank; each sheet is identified only by a first name in its file name (for example <code>kevinds_day2.html</code>). The Kevin and Scott sheets are the decks Shannon and Lingrell played in the final.<ref name="sf-20608-296865" /> The Greg and Joe sheets do not match the decks posted for Greg Shaw and Joe Olson on Saturday,<ref name="sf-20608-296728" /> so their attribution is uncertain. {{Mystery|question=Whose decks are the Greg and Joe Day 2 sheets, and were they played at the event|section=2008 Texas Match Play Championship Day 2 sheets}}

== Seeding ==

On 16 April 2008 Richards posted his seeding of the bracket, ordered by "playing ability, rustiness and potential"; the top four seeds were listed with first-round byes.<ref name="sf-19288-291667">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=291667#p291667 Texas Match Play Championship Details], mr007agent (Michael Richards), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (16 April 2008).</ref> Later that day [[Matt Lush]] and William Freeman were added, for a total of 30 players, which left only two players with byes.<ref name="sf-19288-291886">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=291886#p291886 Texas Match Play Championship Details], mr007agent (Michael Richards), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (16 April 2008).</ref><ref name="sf-19288-291932">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=291932#p291932 Texas Match Play Championship Details], mr007agent (Michael Richards), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (16 April 2008).</ref><ref name="sf-19288-291924">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=291924#p291924 Texas Match Play Championship Details], mr007agent (Michael Richards), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (16 April 2008).</ref>

== Side events ==

=== Round 1 loser event (26 April) ===

A free event for all players not in round 2 of the main event started about 30 minutes after the end of main-event round 1 (about noon): six games of Swiss open constructed with a final confrontation, with an automatic bid to the [[2008 World Championship]] for the top player.<ref name="sf-19288-270787" /> [[Bobby Hilburn|Bobby Hilbun]] received the Day 2 automatic bid from the Texas MPC consolation event.<ref name="sf-22883-332133" />

=== Watto's Cube Draft Tournament (27 April) ===

A free [[Cube|cube draft]] sealed event of four games, open to all players not in Day 2 of the main event, started at 11 am on Sunday, with an automatic bid for the top player.<ref name="sf-19288-270787" /> [[Matt Lush]] received the Day 2 automatic bid from it.<ref name="sf-22883-332133" />
